description: Travel eSIM provider selling prepaid mobile data plans for 200+ countries that install in about a minute, letting travellers keep their own number for calls and avoid roaming bills.

evidence.summary: Roambee's own partner programme page publishes tiered commission: every partner starts at Tier 1 10%, rising to 15% from €1,000 and 20% from €4,250 in prior-quarter net sales; commission is a percentage of the net amount paid (after discounts and perks, excluding VAT and payment fees), earned on what each customer buys for 12 months, with payouts from €50 by bank transfer, PayPal or USDT and a 30-day last-click window.

The 'No cap' wording on Roambee's homepage applies to free data gifted through its traveller-to-traveller referral scheme, not to partner earnings, so it does not qualify as an uncapped statement; commission_cap is unknown and no creator counts are published, so creator_saturation is unknown.
